# Pull Request

## 📝 Description

Please include a summary of the changes and related context. Explain the "why" not just the "what".

## 🎯 Type of Change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to change)
- [ ] 📚 Documentation update
- [ ] ♻️ Refactoring (no functional change)
- [ ] ⚡ Performance improvement
- [ ] 🧪 Test addition/update
- [ ] 🔧 Configuration change

## 🔗 Related Issues

Closes #(issue number)

## 📋 Checklist

### Code Quality
- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation

### Testing & Verification
- [ ] TypeScript compilation passes (`npm run typecheck`)
- [ ] Build succeeds (`npm run build`)
- [ ] No console errors or warnings
- [ ] Tested on multiple browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari)
- [ ] Tested on mobile devices
- [ ] Manual testing completed

### TypeScript & Types
- [ ] All new functions have proper TypeScript types
- [ ] No `any` types used (except where unavoidable with proper justification)
- [ ] No TypeScript errors or warnings

### Accessibility & UX
- [ ] Changes maintain accessibility standards
- [ ] UI/UX is consistent with existing design
- [ ] Loading states are handled properly
- [ ] Error states are handled properly

### Documentation
- [ ] README updated (if needed)
- [ ] API documentation updated (if needed)
- [ ] Code comments added where necessary
- [ ] Changelog entry added (if needed)

### Dependencies
- [ ] No unnecessary dependencies added
- [ ] All dependencies are up-to-date
- [ ] Security vulnerabilities checked (`npm audit`)
